name: Olena Kovalenko
summary: Registered nurse from Ukraine with 12 years of hospital experience in medical and surgical wards. Relocated to the UK in 2023. Currently caring for a young child and looking for a first UK healthcare or care role while exploring the NMC registration route. English at B1. Honest, calm, and used to working in busy teams.

experience.title: Staff Nurse, Medical-Surgical Ward
achievements: Cared for 12–18 adult patients per shift including post-operative recovery
Took vital signs, changed dressings, and administered prescribed medicines under hospital protocol
Supported families during difficult conversations with the medical team
Mentored junior nurses on infection control and handover
Kept paper and electronic nursing notes

experience.title: Student Nurse placements
experience.employer: Bogomolets National Medical University affiliated hospitals
achievements: Completed clinical placements in medicine, surgery, and elderly care

gaps_or_breaks: Career break from late 2022 for relocation to the UK and full-time childcare for a toddler (now 3 years old). Ready to return to work with school-hours or part-time preferred at first.
constraints: Prefer daytime or school-hours where possible because of childcare
Not yet on the NMC register — must not be presented as a UK registered nurse
Needs a role that can start while English continues to improve
